body:
I found this while rendering grouped bars over years. A run of `Year` values gets banded, but its semantic type stays `temporal`. The local dodge used that type to pick the band axis, so it fell back to `y`:

```diff
 groupedBarChartDef.instantiate
-  axisField = x.type is nominal/ordinal ? x.field : y.field   // years → y
+  axisField = offsetCh === "xOffset" ? x.field : y.field
```

```text
groupby: ["y"]  → bars grouped by value; the rest draw zero wide (M128.24,41.73h0v278.26h0Z)
groupby: ["x"]  → one lane per series in each year
```

The `dodge` option's `check` in Grouped Bar and Boxplot made the same choice. It now picks the axis with `detectBandedAxisForceDiscrete`, the same function `declareLayoutMode` uses.

On `dev`, 12 consecutive years still show the bug; in 0.5.1, three are enough.

Verification:
- `tests/year-band-dodge.test.ts`: 3 tests that fail before the fix and pass after.
- `flint-js`: 2854 tests pass, `tsc` passes, and `eslint` is clean.
title: fix(vegalite): a dodge over years lanes each year, not each value
